en.summary: Thursday 5 November 2026: the Moon spends the morning in Virgo near 25°, waning and about 16% lit, then enters Libra later in the day. Venus, retrograde in Libra, makes a near-exact sextile to Jupiter and a trine to the North Node. The Sun and Mercury, which is retrograde in Scorpio, sit almost conjunct, while Mars and Jupiter remain together in Leo.

signs.belier:
Aries, finishing practical tasks brings relief: the Moon is still in Virgo this morning in your sector of work, health and habits, waning and about 16% lit, then enters Libra later and shifts focus toward partnerships.

Venus, retrograde in Libra, makes a near-exact sextile to Jupiter and a trine to the North Node, which helps an old contact, method or hope return in a useful form. The Sun and retrograde Mercury sit almost conjunct in Scorpio, so honesty about a deep or financial matter comes more easily if you speak slowly.

Mars, your ruler, still conjunct Jupiter in Leo, keeps creative drive high if you finish before you start. Mars and Jupiter remain together in Leo, keeping enthusiasm high. With the waning Moon, complete what is half done before you open a brand-new file after the Libra ingress.

fr.summary: Jeudi 5 novembre 2026 : la Lune passe la matinée en Vierge vers 25°, décroissante et éclairée à 16 % environ, puis entre en Balance plus tard dans la journée. Vénus, rétrograde en Balance, forme un sextile quasi exact à Jupiter et un trigone au Nœud nord. Le Soleil et Mercure, rétrograde en Scorpion, sont presque conjoints, tandis que Mars et Jupiter restent ensemble en Lion.
